title: Breakthrough Achieved in 6.59 km Long Tunnel-14 of Rishikesh-Karnaprayag Rail Project
subtitle: Milestone Marks Significant Progress in Construction of the Strategically Important Rail Project in Uttarakhand
body_text: Indian Railways has achieved the main tunnel breakthrough of Tunnel-14, measuring 6.59 km, in the Rishikesh-Karnaprayag Rail Project today in Rudraprayag district of Uttarakhand. The breakthrough connects the two excavated sections of the tunnel, comprising 4.7 km from Portal-1 (Sumerpur) and 1.79 km from Portal-2 (Marora). https://www.instagram.com/reel/DgPfP2Py2co/?evlk=bjFvYXRoMndsMXVy At Portal-1 (T14P1), a 110-metre stretch of the triple-track tunnel was excavated through loose soil beneath inhabited areas, with 20-30 metres of soil and rock above it. Specialised techniques, including pre-excavation and multi-drifting, were used to ensure safe excavation. At Portal-2 (T14P2), the slope was secured through 30–35-metre-deep micropiles, 15–20-metre-long rock bolts and consolidation grouting. These measures enabled the launch of the main tunnel drive in March 2024, following the resolution of ground settlement issues at Marora and matters related to land and home acquisition. Approximately 100 metres of mechanical excavation was undertaken at Portal-2. To ensure the safety of nearby settlements, controlled blasting was carried out strictly during daytime hours near both portals. Specialised ventilation systems were also deployed throughout the 4.7 km excavation drive from Portal-1 to ensure the supply of fresh air and regulate temperature inside the tunnel. The breakthrough marks an important milestone in the construction of the Rishikesh–Karnaprayag Rail Project, an important railway infrastructure initiative aimed at improving rail connectivity in Uttarakhand. The project is expected to provide better connectivity to the hill regions, facilitate travel for pilgrims and tourists, and support regional development by improving accessibility to important destinations in the state. ***** Dharmendra Tewari / Dr. Nayan Solanki / Vanshita Jaiswal /Vikas Jha
